data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'arj' which means to be safe or secure. This name conveys a sense of strength and protection. In Islamic history, Arjmand is a name given to those who are righteous and powerful in their faith. The name Arjmand carries the meaning “Majestic, powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arjmand usually hope their child will grow to embody majestic, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
